abilities.description: Active abilities that cost resources or have limited uses. Organized by calling. Effect schemas use handler keys (heal, dodge, extraAction, weapon_attack, etc.) for generic dispatch.

dedication.name: Steady Nerve
dedication.description: You have a well of inner resolve to draw upon. As a bonus action, choose one: Heal (regain 1d8 + your level + CON modifier HP) or Dodge (attackers have disadvantage until start of your next turn).

options.name: Heal
options.description: Regain 1d8 + level + CON modifier hit points

options.name: Dodge
options.description: Until the start of your next turn, attack rolls against you have disadvantage

dedication.name: Action Surge
dedication.description: You can push yourself beyond normal limits. On your turn, take one additional action. Once per short rest. Exemplar capstone (level 10) grants a second use per short rest.

dedication.name: Precision Strike
dedication.description: Before making an attack roll, spend 1 Resolve to add your maneuver die to the roll. Declare before the attack roll is made.

dedication.name: Trip Attack
dedication.description: On a hit, add your maneuver die to the damage. The target must succeed on a STR saving throw or be knocked Prone.

dedication.name: Riposte
dedication.description: When an enemy misses you with a melee attack, use your reaction to make a weapon attack against them. Add your maneuver die to the damage.

dedication.name: Menacing Attack
dedication.description: On a hit, add your maneuver die to the damage. The target must succeed on a WIS saving throw or be Frightened of you until the end of their next turn.

dedication.name: Pushing Attack
dedication.description: On a hit, add your maneuver die to the damage. The target must succeed on a STR saving throw or be Pushed — they cannot make melee attacks against you next turn.

dedication.name: Rally
dedication.description: As a bonus action, spend 1 Resolve to bolster your resolve. Gain temporary HP equal to your maneuver die roll + your CON modifier.

dedication.name: Parry
dedication.description: When you are hit by a melee attack, use your reaction to reduce the damage by your maneuver die roll + your CON modifier.

dedication.name: Disarming Attack
dedication.description: On a hit, add your maneuver die to the damage. The target must succeed on a STR saving throw or suffer -2 to attack rolls until the start of their next turn.

dedication.name: Sworn Strike
dedication.description: On a melee hit, spend 1–3 Resolve. Deal 1d8 radiant damage per Resolve spent (+1d8 bonus vs undead or fiends). Once per attack.

dedication.name: Aid the Vulnerable
dedication.description: Spend 1–3 Resolve to heal a target for (Resolve spent × CON modifier) + level HP. Alternatively, spend 1 Resolve to cure one curable condition.
